measurements.note: Complete native crown envelope, including final beads and ornament placements.

measurements.label: Ring size
measurements.note: Closed components clear radius 9.867606 mm. Four inherited open/nonmanifold frameworks still lack closed-material-solid certification; their native edges show no intrusion.

measurements.label: Border bead diameter
measurements.note: All separately modeled bow and leaf-border beads were replaced: 124 bow and 84 leaf spheres. Counts and spacing change to avoid overlaps.

changes.title: Crown widened to 25 mm.
changes.detail: The original non-bead ornament and setting shapes are repositioned rigidly. They are not stretched.

changes.title: Every separate bead border rebuilt.
changes.detail: 208 exact 1 mm spheres replace the original smaller bow and leaf beads. Global conflict selection creates fewer beads and visibly wider gaps on crowded leaf borders.

changes.title: Hollow supports and lower insert.
changes.detail: Four new support elements connect the widened crown. Redundant bars across the open bow windows are removed. The central lower insert is hollowed, retaining solid joining ends.

changes.title: Rim clearance corrected.
changes.detail: The outer rim skins move by at most 0.0217 mm in X/Z before fresh 0.2 mm walls are built. Crown-width coordinates are unchanged.

changes.title: Shared-bow exception.
changes.detail: The model 7 bow replaces the original model 6 support skin. Its outer surfaces agree numerically, while one localized inner cutout differs by up to 0.2781 mm.

qa.label: Native geometry and identity
qa.detail: 307 native BREPs are valid. Four inherited floral assemblies remain open/nonmanifold.

qa.label: Width, beads and contact
qa.detail: 25.000 mm complete crown and 208 exact 1 mm spheres. No sphere overlaps; every sphere has a metallic carrier contact witness.

qa.label: Settings and filigree shapes
qa.detail: All retained non-bead shapes match their recorded rigid source placements. Every final bead has conservative separation bounds from retained gemstone solids; this is not a production setting-clearance approval.

qa.label: Structural connection and walls
qa.detail: Structural contact graph is connected. Bow wall samples:0.19914–0.20122 mm; fresh rim walls:0.19998–0.20008 mm; central cavity walls:0.199999–0.200003 mm.

qa.label: Production release
qa.detail: Final union, drainage/venting, material/process suitability and all manufacturing tolerances require the jeweller’s review.

limitations: Four inherited open/nonmanifold floral assemblies and the localized 0.2781 mm inner-cutout change must be reviewed before production.
Solid joining ends and component intersections are intentionally thicker than 0.2 mm. No uniform whole-ring wall certificate is claimed.
Closed internal cavities need a production drainage/venting and cleaning plan. Parts remain separate editable components.
Bead counts are lower than in the source and spacing is less dense on some leaf borders. The 1 mm diameter requirement takes priority over preserving the original small-bead count.
The shared bow includes toleranced trim repairs: up to 0.00351 mm local movement and 0.00736 mm boundary tolerance. It is not a casting-release certification.
The smallest bead-to-bead gap is 0.00058 mm, below the 0.001 mm document modeling tolerance. Mathematical non-overlap is not a production clearance allowance.

changes.title: Three rows become seven.
changes.detail: The original 9.85496 mm crown becomes a 25.000 mm mosaic using alternating rigid native rows.

changes.title: Original motif sizes retained.
changes.detail: 462 native motif components retain their shapes and setting dimensions; only positions and row count change.

changes.title: Border beads rebuilt.
changes.detail: 516 exact 1 mm spheres replace the smaller source beads. Counts and spacing change, with wider local gaps around crowded borders.

changes.title: Hollow construction and gauge.
changes.detail: Nine new hollow galleries/ties and a hollowed central lower insert are included. The insert retains solid joining ends; its exterior is preserved apart from the small EU 62 bore correction.

qa.label: Native geometry and identity
qa.detail: 989 valid, closed, manifold native BREPs. Exact-native GLB covers 989/989 objects. Original shank shape and original source archives are unchanged.

qa.label: Width and beads
qa.detail: 25.000 mm full crown;516 exact 1 mm spheres with no mathematical overlap. This does not establish manufacturing clearance.

qa.label: Contact and walls
qa.detail: Native setting/gallery and bead/gallery contact witnesses pass. Gallery and tie walls are nominal 0.2 mm.450 central cavity wall witnesses measure 0.199999–0.200003 mm.

qa.label: Bead–gemstone separation
qa.detail: All 39,732 pairs between 516 beads and 77 retained gemstones are conservatively separated, with no unresolved cases. This is not a production-setting allowance.

qa.label: Production release
qa.detail: Supports remain separate editable intersecting solids. Final union, all setting clearances, drainage/venting, material strength and print/cast suitability remain for the jeweller.

limitations: Solid joining ends and component intersections are intentionally thicker than 0.2 mm. No uniform whole-ring wall certificate is claimed.

Closed internal cavities need a planned production drainage/venting and cleaning strategy. A sampled check confirms the new central void remains mostly free, with a small local inherited-shank overlap.
Milgrain counts and spacing change. Some borders have visible gaps; the tightest bead separation is below the 0.001 mm modeling tolerance. CAD contact does not establish a robust casting union.
Minimum conservative bead-to-gemstone clearance is 0.003424 mm. Positive mathematical separation is not a workshop production allowance.
